risk_summary: The disclosure presents a broadly positive strategic and liquidity outlook but identifies meaningful exposure to China real estate weakness, foreign exchange volatility, inflation, supply-chain disruption and geopolitical conditions. The cybersecurity incident caused operational disruption and approximately $30 million of fiscal 2023 net-income impact, while investigation and remediation remained ongoing. Risk discussion is detailed but includes substantial forward-looking qualifiers and some boilerplate language.
